audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart contradicted both the packet chart and its own whys: whys[0]/whys[1] argue Karma owns levels 1-2 while the rows said Skill and Gangplank, and whys[3]/whys[4] hand Gangplank 4-5 and 6 while the rows said Skill.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Karma, Karma, Skill, Gangplank, Gangplank, Gangplank, Gangplank, and the mirror (gangplank__karma) was already corrected to exactly that ordering. Karma's 950 Q beats Parrrley's 625 before he owns barrel chains; from 4-5 he chains kegs faster than one Inspire shield covers.
audit.corrected: Rows 0,1 -> Karma; row 2 -> Skill; rows 3,4 -> Gangplank. Proposed as matched full/content pairs in one atomic group. Ratings left untouched so the mirror is not disturbed.

audit.whatIsWrong: Late-game text said his barrels out-range Karma without naming a number, and never mentioned that Cannon Barrage deals true damage.
audit.why: Karma's Q is 950 range; Cannon Barrage is global (30000) and its damage is true, so buying magic resist against a fed Gangplank is the wrong answer. Karma has no late solo spike, which the page had right.
audit.corrected: whys[6] now names the 950 range and the true damage so the reader stops buying MR into it.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Soulflare' was used four times as the name of Karma's Mantra-empowered Q, and the cleanse interaction never named Remove Scurvy, gave no cooldown, and never told the reader to buy Grievous Wounds.
audit.why: Riot's current text names no 'Soulflare' — the Mantra Q bonus is described as a cataclysm and the ultimate is simply Mantra; the mirror audit already removed the same fabrication. Remove Scurvy is Gangplank's W, 22/20/18/16/14s, and it cures crowd control, so it hard-answers Focused Resolve's root and heals through chip poke.
audit.corrected: Soulflare replaced with Mantra-Q throughout the edited fields; Remove Scurvy named with its 22s rank-1 timer in whys[2]; wants.foe[1] now points at anti-heal; Parrrley's 4.5s written into the do's.

edits.after: Mantra is up at level 1, so your Mantra-Q cataclysm zone out-pokes his first keg from 950 and threatens a lead before he can chain barrels.
